title: Community garden workday
summary: [00:00-00:36] Workday scope — Participant A proposes front-bed tidying, tool sorting, and labelling for Sunday’s volunteer morning; Participants B and C discuss the work • [00:36-01:11] Site conditions — Participant B reports standing water in the back corner and a loose folding table; Participant A rules out work in that corner and keeps the table in storage • [01:11-01:39] Timing — Participant A confirms a 10–noon session, with coordinators arriving earlier to set up • [01:39-02:18] Tools & gloves — Participant C reviews available tools and gloves and discusses borrowing additional gloves from a neighbouring group • [02:18-03:03] Mulch delivery — Participant C says a mulch delivery has been offered but not ordered; Participant A agrees to plan without it while Participant C checks how long the quote will remain valid • [03:03-03:52] Weather decision — Participant B will check the site Saturday afternoon; Participant A will decide at 6 that evening whether weather and path conditions require postponement; no alternative date has been chosen
